text:
maya: Quick sync — need short-form landing copy updates for Hosted API, Dedicated, and Private ahead of Monday's webinar. Goal: 3-line hero, one-line sub, and CTA copy for each page. Also need 2 launch-post hooks + an inbound routing sketch (webinar signups -> trial/demo/SDR). I can split: @leo take Hosted, @toni Dedicated, @sam Private, @ellie inbound routing. Deadline: Friday 12pm PT. Links to current pages (for context): https://redwood.example/hosted https://redwood.example/dedicated https://redwood.example/private :rocket:

leo: Got it — will do 3 hero options + CTA for Hosted. Short, developer-first tone.

leo: Hosted hero drafts:
1) "Production LLM inference, without the infra overhead."
2) "Fast, reliable hosted API for real applications."
3) "Ship LLM features faster — we handle serving and scaling."
CTA options: `Get API key`, `Start hosted trial`, `Explore hosted API` — leaning `Get API key`.

toni: Dedicated drafts:
1) "Reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput."
2) "Dedicated fleets with autoscale and SLA-backed SLOs."
Subline idea: "Configurable capacity, burst options, and enterprise SLAs." CTA: `Request Dedicated` or `Talk to sales`. Thoughts on mentioning 'SLA-backed latency' vs 'latency SLOs'? Prefer SLOs for legal safety.

sam: Private page copy ideas:
Hero: "Private deployments for regulated and sensitive workloads."
Subline: "VPC, on-prem, and customer-managed keys (KMS/HSM)."
Bullets (short): "Isolated control plane, audit logs, bring-your-own-network." CTA: `Contact sales` or `Schedule private trial`.

ellie: Inbound routing quick sketch — keep it simple so ops can implement:
```
webinar-signup -> tag: webinar_attendee
  0-24h: send recording + guided quickstart email (marketing)
  if clicks 'Request demo' -> route to SDR Queue A (region-based)
  if clicks 'Start trial' -> send self-serve onboarding + product emails
  if high-activity (>3 API calls in 48h) -> flag as PQL and alert AE
```
Also two social launch hooks (short):
- Hook A: "How we cut inference tail-latency for real products — join our webinar."
- Hook B: "Three ways to make LLM features predictable at scale (hosted, dedicated, private)."

maya: Nice — please keep each hero to ~10–12 words max. @leo, use 'Get API key' as primary CTA if it fits. @toni change 'SLA-backed latency' -> 'latency SLOs' for legal review. @sam keep the Private copy explicit about KMS and audit logs. @ellie will take routing sketch and turn into a one-slide matrix for ops.

deploy-bot: Reminder set for maya: deadline Fri 12:00 PT — 1 day before webinar.

maya: Thanks — I'll consolidate into a copy doc and ping legal on SLO phrasing. Final ask: each of you add one conservative benchmark blurb (one sentence) we can use under hero: e.g., performance + cost benefit in cautious language (no hard claims). Aim for something like 'low 100s ms 99th latency for common models; unit cost materially lower than naive self-host at scale.' Post your one-liners in this thread. :thumbsup:
